merge_ruling.for_merge: Kennicott is an uncommon surname and the town holds no third bearer.
merge_ruling.against_merge: The middle initials L and H disagree, and neither card documents the man — one is a poll-list line graded G2a, the other is the Democrat and Norris 1844. No anchor, so C4 does not fire. His call.
